request.query: Zero component of a Hasse Schmidt derivation is the identity endomorphism

content.text:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv_zero",
      "informal_name": "Hasse Derivative of Order Zero Equals Identity Map",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module R V],\n  LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R 0 = LinearMap.id",
      "informal_description": "The Hasse derivative of order $ 0 $ on Laurent series with coefficients in an $ R $-module $ V $ is the identity linear map, meaning it acts as the identity transformation on all Laurent series, leaving each series unchanged when $ k = 0 $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.RingTheory.LaurentSeries"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Polynomial.hasseDeriv_zero",
      "informal_name": "Zeroth Hasse Derivative is Identity Map",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.hasseDeriv 0 = LinearMap.id",
      "informal_description": "For any semiring $ R $, the Hasse derivative of order 0 on the polynomial ring $ R[X] $ is the identity linear map, i.e., $ D^{(0)}(f) = f $ for all polynomials $ f \\in R[X] $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Polynomial.hasseDeriv_zero'",
      "informal_name": "Zeroth Hasse Derivative is Identity",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (f : Polynomial R), (Polynomial.hasseDeriv 0) f = f",
      "informal_description": "The Hasse derivative of order zero applied to any polynomial $ f $ is equal to $ f $ itself, i.e., $ D^{(0)}(f) = f $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Derivation.coe_zero",
      "informal_name": "Zero Derivation is the Zero Function",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring A]\n  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_3 : Algebra R A] [inst_4 : Module A M] [inst_5 : Module R M], ⇑0 = 0",
      "informal_description": "The zero derivation from $ A $ to $ M $ over $ R $, when viewed as a function, maps every element of $ A $ to the zero element of $ M $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.RingTheory.Derivation.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Derivation.coe_zero_linearMap",
      "informal_name": "Zero Derivation Coerces to Zero Linear Map",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring A]\n  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_3 : Algebra R A] [inst_4 : Module A M] [inst_5 : Module R M], ↑0 = 0",
      "informal_description": "The zero derivation from $ A $ to $ M $ over $ R $, when viewed as an $ R $-linear map, coincides with the zero linear map from $ A $ to $ M $. Formally, coercing the zero derivation to a linear map yields the zero linear map.",
      "path": "Mathlib.RingTheory.Derivation.Basic"
    }
  ]
}

items.informal_name: Hasse Derivative of Order Zero Equals Identity Map
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module R V],
  LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R 0 = LinearMap.id
items.informal_description: The Hasse derivative of order $ 0 $ on Laurent series with coefficients in an $ R $-module $ V $ is the identity linear map, meaning it acts as the identity transformation on all Laurent series, leaving each series unchanged when $ k = 0 $.

items.informal_name: Zero Derivation Coerces to Zero Linear Map
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring A]
  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_3 : Algebra R A] [inst_4 : Module A M] [inst_5 : Module R M], ↑0 = 0
items.informal_description: The zero derivation from $ A $ to $ M $ over $ R $, when viewed as an $ R $-linear map, coincides with the zero linear map from $ A $ to $ M $. Formally, coercing the zero derivation to a linear map yields the zero linear map.
